full_name: Michael Crescimanno | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: In his recent work, Michael Crescimanno, a professor of physics at Youngstown State University (YSU), focuses primarily on quantum optics theory applied to new all-optical atomic time standards and to properties of cold atom systems of low effective dimensionality.
